pages.name: English: Anglo-Dutch
pages.notes: Plan had ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8 and vague bishop ideas. Rewritten around the three Dutch set-ups and the fight for e4.

pages.name: English: Anglo-Dutch
pages.notes: Overview called a Classical Dutch a Stonewall; plan had the c3-knight going via e1 and d3 to e5. Rewritten.

pages.name: Hickmann Gambit, English
pages.notes: Plan had Bg2 without g3 and an open e-file that is half-open; plans generic. Rewritten around 3...exd3 4.Bxd3 and Qh5+; reviewer rejection (Nf3 blocks Qh5+) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Caro-Kann Defence
pages.notes: Plan had Qb3 attacking d5 through White's own c4-pawn and a b4-b5 route. Rewritten around Qb3 against b7 and ...Qb6.

pages.name: English: Caro-Kann Defence
pages.notes: Plans used b4-b5 and c6-d5-e6 as routes. Rewritten around Slav and Réti transpositions.

pages.name: English: Torre Defence
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bg4 a pin (the e2-pawn shields the queen); plan had gxf3 before ...Bxf3 and a b4-b5 route. Rewritten.

pages.name: English Opening: Agincourt Defense, Tarrasch Defense
pages.notes: Plan had ...dxc4 creating an isolated pawn for White and ...cxd4 with no d4-pawn; plans without side prefixes. Rewritten around Bb2, e3/d4, ...d4 and ...b6.

pages.name: English Opening: Agincourt Defense, Wimpy System
pages.notes: Plans had ...cxd4 with no d4-pawn, a3-b4 as a route and plans without side prefixes. Rewritten.

pages.name: English: Neo-Catalan Accepted, 5.Qa4+ Nbd7 6.Qxc4
pages.notes: Plan had ...a6 to stop Nb5 with no knight able to reach b5. Rewritten around ...a6/...b5 gaining time on the c4-queen.

pages.name: English: Neo-Catalan, 4...c6 5.b3
pages.notes: Plan read e5 as a move and used 0-0. Rewritten around the double fianchetto and ...e5 or ...b6/...Bb7.

pages.name: Van Geet Opening: Kluever Gambit
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 3: plan had Nf3 and then Qh5+, which the knight blocks, and ...d5 said to blunt the d3-bishop (only ...g6 does). Reworded and re-reviewed.
